title: Verify the Send to Portal button is not available for Office
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Office role. (Office has Full View but cannot approve a work order line - Review WOs is OFF and Work Order Lines is View only - so Send to Portal must not be available).
At least one work order exists.
steps:
1. Open a work order.
2. Look for the Send to Portal button.
expected: The Send to Portal button is NOT available for the Office role.
